summary: This is an 8-K filing by Benchmark 2026-V21 Mortgage Trust, an asset-backed securities issuing entity, reporting the entry into a material definitive agreement — a pooling and servicing agreement for a commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) transaction. The filing describes the issuance of pass-through certificates and a residual interest backed by 41 fixed-rate mortgage loans on 68 commercial/multifamily properties. This is a routine CMBS securitization disclosure, not a special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing contains no event-driven corporate action; it simply documents the formation and initial closing of a securitization trust.
